training_cutoff: 00:00 ET of each prediction date; one new fitted model per day, reused at arbitrary analysis times that day
history: Latest 252 eligible feature dates, at least 120. Both ETF labels must be finite, complete, and available strictly before training cutoff. No month identity as an input or selector.
label_availability: Conservative full 14-calendar-day contractual window: max(expiry close + 1 second, historical available_at of every regular bar in that window). Early target/stop exits do not enter training sooner than failures. Missing and immature cases remain in the label inventory, excluded from fit.
algorithm: Separate ExtraTreesRegressor net trade-return model per ETF, reusing v2 fixed hyperparameters. No probability claim.
calibration: Prequential bias correction: mean(actual net return - raw forecast) on the latest 60 dates with past as-of out-of-sample forecasts whose full labels have now matured; minimum 40 dates. Those forecasts are never recomputed with newer models. The current fit can learn those matured labels; each calibration forecast was emitted before its own outcome existed.
action: Choose the ETF with the higher bias-corrected expected net trade return if strictly positive; otherwise cash. Missing model/calibration means cash. Deterministic SOXL tie-break. No threshold search.
risk_origin: Keep the pre-May v3 risk choice fixed to isolate daily learning: 50% of settled cash, 3% stop, three full session cooldown after a realized loss. No v3 direction rule or whole-year selection gate is inherited.
exit: Attach +5% take-profit at entry, allow earlier risk stop, mandatory exit by day 14 inclusive calendar days. Inherit v3 gap, conservative same-bar stop-first, fees, settlement and continuous marked-to-market ledger.
comparison: Daily updated model is the only candidate. Diagnostic control freezes its May 1 premarket model and calibration at April 30 information. Do not select between routes using case returns.
acceptance: Previously confirmed arithmetic mean of the three case-month net ledger returns >= 10%, all May-September monthly net ledger returns nonnegative and complete. Geometric growth reported separately. Cash is not return success.
deployment: Failed historical gates mean no qualified new buy. Daily model refresh alone is not acceptance. Arbitrary-time analysis is supported; effect evidence covers the registered premarket clock only. No real brokerage orders.
